model.precision: float32, eager (the released model as is); compiled float16 timed separately

operating_points.rule: N-2 scenarios of the conformal test role that appear in no earlier notebook result (base point, evaluated scenario or hard case) and are not in the K1 base-point partitions 0-1; sorted by scenario id; the first PILOT_BASES are the pilot, the next N_FINAL (set by the pilot's runtime, never by its results) are the final set

contingencies.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(SEED * 1000003 + base scenario id) per base point, so that the cases of a base point do not depend on how many base points are used
contingencies.construction: N2 pick_lines: extra lines removed on top of the base point's outages, grid kept in one piece

gate.rule: fixed before this run: the 10th percentile of GENCO's 99th-percentile active residual over the 2,969 scenarios of notebook 01 (its 'most trusted 10 %')

definitions.verified_safe: converged state (largest mismatch < tol_pu) with no line loading >= 1.0 and no PQ-bus voltage outside its limits
definitions.verified_violation: converged state with at least one such violation
definitions.unresolved: no start converged within the iteration cap; never a pass
definitions.reference: the verified state of the classical multi-start workflow; when it has none, the verified state of another workflow if any (then the case counts as resolved only with GENCO assistance, and that state is checked with PYPOWER)
definitions.missed_decision: a line overloaded or a PQ bus outside its limits in the reference that the answer does not show
definitions.false_alarm: an unresolved verdict on a case with a reference
primary_metrics: missed decisions per workflow with their denominators
cases resolved only with GENCO assistance
end-to-end time per case (median, 95th percentile) overall and on the cases the classical workflow could not solve
definitions.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over base points (BOOTSTRAP resamples, 2.5-97.5 percentiles); one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson with the number of base points as n for zero counts

sizing.rule: N_FINAL = min(MAX_BASES, floor(TIME_BUDGET_MIN * 60 / seconds per base point in the pilot))
